regional_findings.shared_decision: 桌布 is attested in TW and HK. Use neutral 預覽/下載/原圖/背景圖片 in prose rather than a synonym chain.

editorial_recommendations: Concise names such as Oppo Find X10 桌布; no boilerplate brand suffix.
Do not stack 桌布/壁紙/牆紙/Wallpaper in every title. 背景圖片 is shared Apple TW/HK usage.
內建/原廠/原裝內置 require source evidence. No blanket 4K/官方/免費/完整合集 claim.
Neutral 主畫面 and 鎖定畫面 serve both regions; avoid strongly regional colloquial language.
